# opengwasr

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/opengwas/opengwasr/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/opengwas/opengwasr/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

The R client for OpenGWAS data. It queries Analyses, Associations, top
hits and LD either through the OpenGWAS API or from Store Releases
downloaded to your own machine, and replaces
[ieugwasr](https://github.com/MRCIEU/ieugwasr) and
[gwasvcf](https://github.com/MRCIEU/gwasvcf) as the data-access layer
for [TwoSampleMR](https://github.com/MRCIEU/TwoSampleMR).

> **Status: design.** In development: the package skeleton and its
> checks are in place, and no query functions exist yet. The vocabulary
> is in [GLOSSARY.md](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/GLOSSARY.md)
> and the decisions so far are in
> [docs/adr/](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/docs/adr/).

# Package index

## Getting started

Find Analyses, then read their Associations.

- [`og_analyses()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_analyses.md)
  : Find Analyses
- [`og_tophits()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_tophits.md)
  : Top hits of Analyses
- [`og_associations()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_associations.md)
  : Associations of variants in Analyses
- [`og_phewas()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_phewas.md)
  : PheWAS: variants across Analyses
- [`og_range()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_range.md)
  : Associations in a genomic range
- [`og_variants_rsid()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_variants_rsid.md)
  [`og_variants_chrpos()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_variants_rsid.md)
  : Look up variants by rsID or position
- [`og_provenance()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_provenance.md)
  : Provenance of a query's result

## Large queries and Jobs

Run many queries at once, or collect them yourself.

- [`og_submit()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_submit.md)
  [`og_job_status()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_submit.md)
  [`og_job_result()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_submit.md)
  [`og_job_cancel()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_submit.md)
  : Run queries as Jobs without waiting

## LD

LD Stores, LD matrices, proxies and reflookup, and clumping.

- [`og_ld_stores()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_ld_stores.md)
  : List the LD Stores
- [`og_ld_matrix()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_ld_matrix.md)
  : LD matrices
- [`og_ld_proxies()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_ld_proxies.md)
  : LD proxies
- [`og_ld_reflookup()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_ld_reflookup.md)
  : Is a variant in the LD Store?
- [`og_clump()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_clump.md)
  : Clump Associations you already have

## Your own data

- [`og_alid()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_alid.md)
  : Give your own summary statistics ALIDs

## Sources and access

Where queries are answered, and who you are signed in as.

- [`og_api()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_api.md)
  : Create the API Source
- [`og_local()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_local.md)
  : Create a Local Source
- [`og_local_check()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_local_check.md)
  : Check the setup of a Local Source
- [`og_ld_resource()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_ld_resource.md)
  : The LD resource a Source carries
- [`og_status()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_status.md)
  [`og_user()`](https://opengwas.github.io/opengwasr/reference/og_status.md)
  : Check the API and your access
